full_judgment: For that the Single Bench of the High Court Division erred in failing to consider the facts, that the suit land was acquired by the Government vide Gazette notification dated 2.4.1956 and subsequently the Secretary of the Board of Revenue by letters dated 19.1.1950 and 9.2.1955 gave responsibility of the suit land to the Forest Department (the present petitioners) for managing the suit land.
